Create new *_map_total_n() functions

Source: R/function-map-total-n.R
function_map_total_n.Rd

function_map_total_n() creates a total-n mapper from a basic mapper such as grim_map(): a function for two groups whose statistics are reported with the total sample size but without the group sizes, as grim_map_total_n() is. It uses disperse_total() to create pairs of hypothetical group sizes that add up to the total, and tests the reported statistics against each pair.

See vignette("consistency-tests-in-depth"), section Total-n mapper.

function_map_total_n() is a developer tool: it may change in a minor release, with a NEWS entry.

Usage

function_map_total_n(
  .fn,
  .reported,
  .name_test,
  .name_key_result = "consistency",
  .name_class = NULL,
  .dispersion = 0:5,
  .n_min = 1L,
  .n_max = NULL,
  .constant = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

.fn

A basic mapper function such as grim_map(), typically made by function_map(). It must return its input data frame with a logical column named by .name_key_result added.

.reported

String. Names of the group-specific statistics reported alongside the total, such as "x" for GRIM and c("x", "sd") for DEBIT. In the input of the factory-made function, each appears as two columns with the suffixes 1 and 2, such as x1 and x2.

.name_test

String (length 1). Plain-text name of the test, such as "GRIM", for messages and the output's class.

.name_key_result

(Experimental) String (length 1). Name of the key result column. Default is "consistency". Must be the value that .fn was created with.

.name_class

String. Optionally, one or more classes to add to the output. Default is NULL.

.dispersion, .n_min, .n_max, .constant

Passed on to disperse_total(), with the defaults from there. .n_min may also be a function of the settings of .fn, as a named list, that returns the default n_min for a call; the factory-made function's n_min then defaults to NULL, which stands for that value.

...

These dots must be empty.

Value

A function such as these:

Factory-made functionReported statisticsTest vignette
grim_map_total_n()"x"vignette("grim-in-depth")
grimmer_map_total_n()"x", "sd"vignette("grimmer-in-depth")
debit_map_total_n()"x", "sd"vignette("debit")

The settings of .fn, i.e., its arguments after ..., such as rounding, are arguments of this function as well, with the same defaults. So are its helper arguments, such as items_averaged. Its ... pass any other arguments on to .fn, which is only of use for a .fn without ... of its own.

Details

To export a factory-made function from another package, follow the purrr FAQ on adverbs; see vignette("consistency-tests-in-depth"), section Context and export.

Conventions

Name the factory-made function after .fn with _total_n appended, as in grim_map_total_n() from grim_map(). The output has the classes "scrutiny_map_total_n" and "scrutiny_{tolower(.name_test)}_map_total_n". Prefix any class you add via .name_class with your package's name, as in "mypkg_schlim_map_total_n".

References

Bauer, P. J., & Francis, G. (2021). Expression of Concern: Is It Light or Dark? Recalling Moral Behavior Changes Perception of Brightness. Psychological Science, 32(12), 2042–2043. https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/09567976211058727

See also

function_map_seq()

Examples

# Function definition of `grim_map_total_n()`:
grim_map_total_n <- function_map_total_n(
  .fn = grim_map,
  .reported = "x",
  .name_test = "GRIM"
)
